tasks.label: docker: build builder image (arm64 cross)
tasks.detail: amd64 image that cross-compiles to aarch64 - no qemu, native speed
tasks.command: sg docker -c 'docker buildx build -f Dockerfile.arm64-cross -t openautobridge-flutter-cross-arm64 --load .'

tasks.label: docker: flutter build linux (example)
tasks.command: sg docker -c 'docker run --rm -t -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace/example openautobridge-flutter-builder bash -c "flutter pub get && flutter build linux"'

tasks.label: docker: flutter clean (example)
tasks.command: sg docker -c 'docker run --rm -t -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace/example openautobridge-flutter-builder flutter clean'

tasks.label: docker: flutter build linux arm64 (example)
tasks.detail: Cross-compile just the arm64 app + plugin (no flutter-drm bundle)
tasks.command: mkdir -p .cache/pub .cache/ccache .cache/home && sg docker -c "docker run --rm -t --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/workspace/.cache/home -e PUB_CACHE=/workspace/.cache/pub -e CCACHE_DIR=/workspace/.cache/ccache -v '${workspaceFolder}:/workspace' -w /workspace/example openautobridge-flutter-cross-arm64 bash -c 'flutter pub get && flutter build linux --release --target-platform=linux-arm64'" && ln -snf ${workspaceFolder} example/linux/flutter/ephemeral/.plugin_symlinks/open_auto_bridge_flutter

tasks.label: debuglantern: upload
tasks.detail: Upload the existing dist/flutter-drm-arm64-debug bundle and start it under gdbserver

tasks.label: debuglantern: build & upload
tasks.detail: Cross-compile the arm64 debug bundle, then upload and start it under gdbserver
tasks.command: mkdir -p .cache/pub .cache/ccache .cache/home && sg docker -c "docker run --rm -t --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/workspace/.cache/home -e PUB_CACHE=/workspace/.cache/pub -e CCACHE_DIR=/workspace/.cache/ccache -e HOST_ROOT_DIR='${workspaceFolder}' -v '${workspaceFolder}:/workspace' -w /workspace openautobridge-flutter-cross-arm64 bash scripts/build_flutter_drm_release_arm64.sh example" && bash scripts/debuglantern_deploy.sh --arch arm64 --target ${input:dlTarget}
